name: AT&T Points Plus® Card from Citi
effective_cost: Free, with no annual fee, and can net a recurring statement credit if you already spend $1,000+/cycle
balance_transfer_fee: Either $5 or 5% of the amount of each transfer, whichever is greater
penalty_apr_trigger: Making a late payment or a payment that's returned
pay_over_time_fee: Up to 1.72% per month, for Citi Flex Plan balances subject to a Plan Fee
late_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another late payment occurs within 6 billing cycles
returned_payment_fee: $30, or $41 if another returned payment occurs within 6 billing cycles

welcome_bonus.requirement: after you spend $1,000 in purchases in the first 3 months of account opening

verdict.text: Good if you spend $1,000+ a cycle; AT&T's bill discount isn't a card perk

earn_note: A separate $20 statement credit is issued each billing cycle you make $1,000 or more in net purchases. It's a flat $20, so it equals 2% only at exactly $1,000 and falls after that (1% at $2,000). AT&T's grocery rate includes grocery delivery services. No caps found on the bonus-category earning, and points don't expire.

redemption_options.method: Gift cards & Shop with Points at checkout
Travel rewards booked through Citi's ThankYou Travel portal

points.per_100k: $1,000, or somewhat more through select travel/gift-card redemptions
points.note: Citi lists gift cards, travel, shopping with participating retailers, cash by direct deposit or check, statement credits, transfers to participating partners' programs and charitable donations as redemption options. It doesn't publish which transfer partners this card can use or at what ratios. Points don't expire.

transfer_partners.highlight: Citi lists transfers to participating partners' programs as a redemption option on this card, but doesn't publish which partners or at what ratios, so none are listed here. Citi's full ThankYou partner list goes with Strata Premier and Strata Elite.

credits.name: $20 statement credit each billing cycle
credits.subtitle: $20 a cycle when you spend $1,000+
credits.description: A $20 statement credit for each billing cycle in which you make $1,000 or more in net purchases (purchases minus returns and refunds), up to $240 a year. Balance transfers, cash advances and cash-like transactions don't count.
tips: Only worth counting if you reliably put $1,000+ a cycle on this card; at exactly $1,000 it's a 2% kicker, and it shrinks as a percentage the more you spend.
A cycle where you fall short earns nothing, so a big purchase is worth timing into a cycle that would otherwise miss.

insurance.detail: Not included, a notable gap given this is a phone carrier's own co-branded card
Not confirmed on Citi's public product page for this card
Not confirmed on Citi's public product page for this card

protection_note: Citi lists Mastercard ID Theft Protection, 24-hour fraud protection and Quick Lock, and publishes no purchase protection, extended warranty, travel insurance or cell phone protection for this card. That's a notable gap for a wireless carrier's own card.
rental_note: No rental car coverage found for this card.

services.name: AT&T wireless bill discount
services.detail: $10/month per eligible wireless line. AT&T, not Citi, provides this discount, and it isn't a benefit of the card: AT&T gives it for AutoPay from a bank account or this card ($5 with a debit card). It starts after 2 bills for wireless and 3 for internet, and AT&T employees, retirees and IMO consumers are excluded.

services.name: AT&T internet bill discount
services.detail: $10/month on eligible AT&T internet ($5 for AT&T Internet Air). AT&T, not Citi, provides this discount, and it isn't a benefit of the card: AT&T gives it for AutoPay from a bank account or this card ($5 with a debit card). It starts after 2 bills for wireless and 3 for internet, and AT&T employees, retirees and IMO consumers are excluded.

services.name: Citi Quick Lock & fraud monitoring
services.detail: Standard Citi account-security tools: lock the card from the app, 24-hour fraud alerts.

services.name: Mastercard ID Theft Protection
services.detail: Identity monitoring and resolution help from Mastercard.

services.name: Priceless Experiences, Citi Entertainment and Citi Flex Pay
services.detail: World Mastercard access to Priceless Experiences, Citi Entertainment presales, and Citi Flex Pay installment plans.

additional_cards.title: Authorized users

benefits.text: Earns ThankYou Points on their spend (into your account)
No protections to share: this card doesn't carry a confirmed insurance suite

additional_cards.note: Free to add, useful mainly for pooling household spend toward the recurring $1,000/cycle $20-credit threshold.

timeline.text: Citi and AT&T refreshed the card: 2x points on AT&T purchases including bill payment, no more foreign transaction fees, and the $20 statement credit now needs only $1,000 in purchases each billing cycle.
AutoPay with this card now qualifies for AT&T's $10 per line wireless and internet discount, the same discount AT&T gives for AutoPay from a bank account.
